cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Carry This with Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to share a burden by framing participation as part of the relationship.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Take half Mum's care-home forms. Being her children can't mean I'm the paperwork child.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Then sit beside me. I'll explain, and you can write.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: All right. It asks for one main contact.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put yourself. I'll help with every answer, but Mum needs to know she can reach either of us.

mechanism: A assigns the sibling an active paperwork role and main-contact responsibility as part of being Mum child, retaining supervisory control while sharing the burden.
confusable: D53 delegates downward for hierarchy alone; D77 makes participation an obligation of the shared relationship.
comparison: Care-home form responsibility differs from former partners deciding what to keep from ten years of letters.
seedUse: Retain D77-a skill objection becoming assisted writing and a main-contact assignment; A continues helping rather than dumping all work.
